shortDescription: Team chat, projects and agents for BRAWADO
longDescription: Brawado is BRAWADO's team workspace: channels, direct messages, shared projects and AI agents in one place, on a relay the organisation runs itself.
notes: Client flavor. Artwork is NOT committed — see clientArtwork in flavors/README.md; it is generated outside this repo by ~/.kikeriki/brand/brawado/make-brawado-assets.py from www.brawado.com. logoStyle is color, not mask: the onboarding landing paints the wordmark with a plain , where a currentColor file resolves to black on the ink canvas. All four cuts are the same lockup because Brawado's own 32px favicon is that lockup — it is their glyph, not a crop of the wordmark. accentColor is the brand red, the site's action colour; the navy #0A1647 is the site's theme-color and carries the app icon, the DMG panel and the ink chrome. OPENROUTER_API_KEY ships empty on purpose: the key is pasted in by its owner, never committed and never baked.
